title: Compute raw RFA Compton profiles
action: Implement the RFA model for TiC (FCC, a=8.176 au) using free‑atom wavefunctions (Clementi & Roetti 1974) and core profiles (Biggs et al 1975). Compute raw J(q) for both charge configurations without convolution, normalize to 12.10 e⁻ over [0,5] au.
description: Raw (unconvolved) Compton profiles for the two charge configurations, q=0.0..5.0 step 0.1 au.

title: Convolve with instrumental resolution and produce final output
action: Convolve the raw profiles with a Gaussian (FWHM=0.41 au) from Manninen et al 1974, re-normalize to 12.10 e⁻, and write the convolved CSV for q=0.0..5.0 step 0.1 au.
description: Convolved Compton profile values J(q) for TiC using the RFA model with two charge configurations, normalized to 12.10 electrons over [0,5] au.
